data.one_liner: Utilities for working with English words, counting syllables, and generating word combinations.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to the top 5000 English words by usage. Calculates the number of syllables in a given word and generates well-sounding word pairs.
use_when: You need to generate random word pairs for usernames or placeholder text
You need to count syllables in English words programmatically
You need a curated list of top English words
avoid_when: You need comprehensive natural language processing or heavy dictionary definitions
You require localization or translation features
strengths: Includes built-in safety filters for generated word pairs
Provides fast, memoized formatting getters on WordPair
weaknesses: Limited to a static list of the top 5000 English words
